comment: The only Vercel env variables .github/workflows/vercel-env.yml may set or remove on cmux.com. tests/test_vercel_env_workflow.py keeps the workflow in step with this file. A secret entry is written as a Vercel Sensitive variable (never readable back); a plain entry as Encrypted. Each value comes from a GitHub secret of the same name in the environment below, never from a workflow input. readBy names the file that reads each variable; until the Run model port lands, those files are on feat-cmux-next.

CMUX_RUN_SANDBOX_USER_IDS.purpose: Stack user ids allowed to start sandboxed Runs (comma or space separated, * for all; empty allows nobody).

CMUX_RUN_WORKER_SECRET.purpose: HMAC key for per-attempt Run worker tokens.

CMUX_RUN_WORKER_TOKEN.purpose: Shared Run worker token, used when no per-attempt scope applies.

CMUX_VM_ALLOCATION_RATE_LIMIT_ID.purpose: Vercel Firewall rule id throttling provider-costing VM operations per billing team; deployed routes fail closed without it.
